(18 February)}} |longest wins= |longest unbeaten= |longest winless= |longest losses= |prevseason=[[2016 Uruguayan Primera División|2016]] |nextseason=[[2018 Uruguayan Primera División season|2018]] }} The '''2017 [[Primera División Uruguaya|Liga Profesional de Primera División]] season''', also known as the '''Campeonato Uruguayo 2017''', was the 114th season of [[Uruguay]]'s top-flight football league, and the 87th in which it is professional. [[Club Nacional de Football|Nacional]] were the defending champions. [[Peñarol]] were the champions after winning the Torneo Clausura and defeating Apertura winners [[Defensor Sporting]] at the championship playoff via [[Penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]]. ==Format== The season was played under the Apertura-Clausura format, with the Apertura being played from February to May and the Clausura from August to November, and the inclusion of an additional tournament between the Apertura and Clausura named ''Torneo Intermedio'' and played from May to July. In the Intermedio, the 16 teams were split into two groups of eight with each club facing the others in their group once, and both group winners played the final. All three tournaments of the season counted for the aggregate table. If the best team in the aggregate table did not win the Apertura or Clausura, it would have gained a berth to the finals, but if one team won both tournaments it would automatically win the championship. The worst three teams in the relegation table were relegated, taking into account the [[2016 Uruguayan Primera División season|2016]] and 2017 seasons.
